stacking_order_note: CBP entry-summary reporting sequence: Ch.99 lines report before the Ch.1-97 line. Where legacy China 301 and 232 both apply, 301 reports first.

rules.rule: Section 232 autos/parts and 301-FL are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. 232 wins. When 232 applies, report 9903.05.90 to suppress 301-FL.
rules.dependency: Valid 10-digit 232 auto-part determination (Proclamation 10908 annex). Chapter-level match is triage only.

rules.rule: Legacy China 301 (9903.88.xx) is NOT suppressed by 232. Both report; 301 first. Worked example: CN 8708 List 3 at 2.5% col-1 = 25% + 25% + 2.5% = 52.5%. Also stacks with Sec 122 when the line is outside the 232 universe. Continues alongside 301-FL (9903.05.31) in the FL era.

Brazil Section 301 country action (9903.05.01 @ 25%, eff. 2026-07-22) is distinct from 301-FL Brazil (9903.05.27 @ 12.5%, eff. 2026-07-24). Both stack when neither is exempt (91 FR 45516 note — additional duties in the subchapter still apply). 232 universe uses Brazil 301 exemption 9903.05.07 and still suppresses 301-FL via 9903.05.90 (R1).
Section 122 (9903.03.01) does NOT stack with Section 232 autos/parts or 232 metals. When 232 applies, report 9903.03.06 and suppress 9903.03.01. China 301 still reports (R2).
rules.source: Sec 122 proclamation 232 carve-out; Cervó / TRE stack examples; CSMS metals guidance

rules.rule: Japan 232 auto parts: if col-1 < 15%, 232 duty equals the difference to reach 15% (9903.94.43). 15% reported on Ch.99 line; ZERO on Ch.1-97 line. Validated: JP 2.5% col-1 -> 232 of 12.5% -> total 15.0%. Same part NOT a 232 auto part -> 9903.05.49 +10% -> total 12.5%.
232 metals duty reported on a separate entry line against metal-content value. Excluded from the parts TOTAL column.
232 metals vs 232 autos precedence on Ch.73/74 derivatives: CONFLICTING published guidance (one source: auto parts exclude steel/alu 232; another: they stack).

Trade-deal codes (9903.94.43/.45/.55/.63): MFN 'capped/removed'. UNRESOLVED between: (A) MFN zeroed entirely — IEEPA/trade-deal rate IS the total; (B) MFN conditionally capped — reduce if above threshold, keep if already 0. Practical impact small on Ch87 (0-2.5% MFN) but material on Ch39 plastics 5.9% / Ch73 bolts 5.8%.
rules.blocking: Total-duty computation for all trade-deal lines

rules.rule: 9903.94.xx family program labeling: 2026-07-27 session = Section 232 autos family; 2026-07-30 corrections = IEEPA/trade-deal. IEEPA was struck down 2026-02-20, so the label carries legal-basis and refund/drawback implications.
HTS classification authority: Item Master ONLY for parts (BL10 HTS is inaccurate). HA30 primary_tariff_num valid for vehicles with Item Master fallback.
45 lines carry active AD/CVD flags in the ACE table — require producer/exporter-level case coverage verification. AD/CVD is outside the Ch.99 stack computation.
